non_blocking_findings: R8 (all _process off), R6 vsync-on half, R1, R7 UNMEASURED: rig became busy (Ollama GPU 81-100%) from 20:28:38; waited to 20:38, still not quiet. The 'game work pushes the tail to the floor' claim (Attribution 7, OQ3 ceiling) is therefore not independently reproduced.

'Time is in RenderingServer.draw' is a wall-clock bracket frame_pre_draw->frame_post_draw (Appendix A). It shows the main thread is inside draw, not that it is waiting; 'waiting for presentation' is inferred from the empty-window draw p50 ~8.5 ms. The doc rates this Medium, which is fair, but Attribution headline states it as fact.

Empty-window floor is comparable on window size, content scale, vsync off, max_fps 0, Dummy audio, Metal; it lacks the bench's window-clamp settle and a 3D scene, so it is a lower bound, not an equal. The empty p99 (15.78) sits under the docked p99 (17.50), consistent with the doc's own ~2 ms game work.
AC commands run as written except: probes hardcode /tmp/iter67_probe (default --out and --timed path), so the mkdir in the AC block is required; macOS has no 'timeout' (not the doc's fault).
R6 pass line 'p99 >= 14.5' is a floor check on a noisy tail (empty p99 spans 15.5-16.3 over 4 runs); adequate.
